import {expectTypeOf} from 'vitest'

type Schema = {anyOf: unknown[]; oneOf: unknown[]; allOf: unknown[]}

export const page = {isPartOf: {id: 'site'}}

export const wrapped = {
  valueOf: () => 1,
  indexOf: (value: string) => value.length,
  lastIndexOf: (value: string) => value.length,
  getPrototypeOf: () => null,
  setPrototypeOf: () => null,
}

export function readSchema(schema: Schema): number {
  expectTypeOf(schema).toBeObject()
  return [1, 2].indexOf(2) + schema.anyOf.length
}

export const proof = 'Of'
